name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Leader
summary: Customer success and account leadership professional with 15+ years driving retention, expansion, and high-value account management across SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments — including direct team leadership and informal mentoring of onboarding and success specialists. Proven ability to own complex, high-stakes accounts, build the playbooks and processes that scale a CS function, and develop other CSMs into stronger operators.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Client Success Lead
bullets: Act as the primary strategic point of contact for a portfolio of service-based businesses, leading discovery and onboarding to deeply understand client goals and market challenges.
Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for B2B clients, managing operational needs and ensuring they achieve their goals with complex SaaS platforms.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.
Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into technical configurations and providing hands-on training.
Maintain clear, organized client records in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Notion, documenting interactions, timelines, and deliverables — and hold client work to a consistent operating standard.
Provide regular performance reporting and strategic recommendations based on rigorous tracking of account health, adoption, and growth.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations and QBRs.
Ensured consistent, high-quality delivery across implementations, addressing client feedback promptly to maintain satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15–20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K–$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Served as trusted advisor on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, helping partners communicate product value.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction across a high-volume partner network.
Functioned in a technical advisory capacity, guiding customers through complex setup of reputation and marketing-automation tools.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Served as team lead for onboarding/launch operations — the primary strategic contact ensuring on-time delivery that accelerated time-to-value.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and a 25% improvement in conversion rates.

Helped build a brand-new Wix team/vertical from proof-of-concept to a profitable, impactful business line — contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training of new hires, and developing sales training for tenured account executives.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Served as strategic advisor on CRM adoption, helping clients build scalable operational systems aligned to growth stage and team structure.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Engaged with leadership on issue escalation, strategic guidance, and account-level risk mitigation.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Managed client accounts focused on campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication for a performance marketing agency.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate — Google / Coursera (2024)
